pattern.description: Pressing Enter on the typed idea ('Add dark mod...') submits it. A grey pending row with a small loading spinner appears at the top of the table, the input row reappears empty one row lower with its placeholder, and every existing idea row moves down one row height.
pattern.why_premium: Submitting gives visible feedback in place: the new idea gets a slot at once (an optimistic row with a spinner), and the input is ready for the next entry. The table grows under the viewer's eye as the narrator says 'capture product opportunities', so the narration and the UI agree.

build_hint.gsap: On submit: tl.set(inputText, {text: ''}) .fromTo(pendingRow, {height: 0, opacity: 0}, {height: rowH, opacity: 1, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out'}) .to([inputRow, rows], {y: '+=' + rowH, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<') .fromTo(spinner, {rotation: 0}, {rotation: 360, repeat: -1, duration: 0.8, ease: 'none'}, '<'). The source is near-instant; a 120-180 ms power2.out makes it smoother.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - submit, fps, config: {damping: 30, stiffness: 500}}); rowsY = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [0, rowH]); pendingRow opacity = p; spinner rotate = (frame - submit) * 15 deg; clear the input text on the submit frame.

notes: One sharp energy spike at f176, then small residue (spinner), so this is a real UI response rather than an authored ease. The grey pending row probably resolves into the real 'Add dark mode' idea row in a later event (skeleton_resolve), but that resolution is not in this window.
